title: Thornwood Seed Library: 2020 annual report, summary section
text: Thornwood Seed Library, established in 2014, completed its seventh year of operation from its premises on Fell Road in Ashgrove. Income came from member dues and a regional cultural grant, in roughly equal measure. The collection stood at forty-two varieties at year end. The spring seed swap moved outdoors in 2020 and still drew several hundred visitors. The library employs two members of staff; all other work is done by volunteers.
notes: Set A. Institutional register, gives the most precise figures in the set.
